generic.name: Generic 10-Axis Probe (Reference)
generic.description: Standard CARE 10-axis capability probe spanning STEM, Humanities, Law, and Reasoning from cais/mmlu and ai2_arc
generic.separation_guarantee: Disjoint sample IDs from held-out evaluation sets

math.name: Mathematical Reasoning Probe (GSM8K)
math.separation_guarantee: 100% disjoint split (train vs test; zero test example exposure)

coding.name: Program Synthesis Probe (MBPP)
coding.separation_guarantee: 100% disjoint split (train vs test; zero test example exposure)

knowledge.name: General Knowledge Probe (MMLU)
knowledge.separation_guarantee: 100% disjoint split (dev vs test; zero test example exposure)

lm.name: General Language Modeling Probe (WikiText-2)
lm.separation_guarantee: 100% disjoint split (train vs test; zero test example exposure)

multi_capability.name: Combined Multi-Capability Probe
multi_capability.aggregation_rule: Equal-weight unit-normalized concatenation C_multi = 1/sqrt(K) * [C_math, C_coding, C_knowledge, C_lm]
multi_capability.separation_guarantee: Strict union of train/dev splits; zero test overlap across all tracks
